default.notes: A free 30-day visitor entry permit is issued on arrival at Roman Tmetuchl International Airport for nearly every nationality; you sign the Palau Pledge stamped into your passport and pay the USD 100 environmental fee, usually inside your airfare.

PW.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Palauan citizens.

US.notes: Under the Compact of Free Association, US citizens may enter, live and work in Palau without a visa — a valid passport, the Palau Pledge and the environmental fee still apply.

FM.notes: Micronesian citizens enter freely under the reciprocal arrangements between the Compact states — confirm current residence and work rules with Palau's Bureau of Immigration for longer stays.

MH.notes: Marshallese citizens enter freely under the reciprocal arrangements between the Compact states — confirm current residence and work rules with Palau's Bureau of Immigration for longer stays.
